source: Segment start times from the owner's Whisper run (2026-10-29); text is the English script for each segment.

segments.text: A customer success manager makes sure every lawyer call ends with a next step the member acts on.
Lawyer calls work when the member arrives prepared and someone follows through afterwards, and at ILP that someone is you.
Each morning the portal puts the members who need you most at the top, with a playbook for each situation.
You own the relationship with each member, and the lawyer keeps the legal advice.
There is no online application yet. Write to the ILP team about your client experience and the languages you speak.
